intent: Restore the fail-closed PR CI-health rebase path by preferring a dedicated least-privilege token, accepting the repository's existing workflow-dispatch PAT as a recovery fallback, and keeping the default GITHUB_TOKEN ineligible for rebase pushes.

negative_controls.name: removing-recovery-pat-fallback-breaks-binding-test
negative_controls.command: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; import subprocess,sys; p=Path('.github/workflows/pr-ci-health.yml'); t=p.read_text(); old='secrets.PR_CI_HEALTH_PUSH_TOKEN || secrets.MERGEMASTERMIKE_PAT || github.token'; assert old in t; p.write_text(t.replace(old,'secrets.PR_CI_HEALTH_PUSH_TOKEN || github.token',1)); r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','pytest','-q','tests/test_pr_ci_health.py::test_workflow_accepts_existing_dispatch_pat_as_recovery_fallback'],check=False); sys.exit(r.returncode)"

commit.message: fix(ci-health): reuse trusted PAT for recovery rebases

interface_mismatches: The hourly PR-health workflow requires a PAT-backed push to trigger exact-head CI, but it ignored the already-provisioned workflow-dispatch PAT and therefore skipped every otherwise-admissible recovery rebase.
honest_blockers: This Session Entry packet was appended after implementation because exact-head CI correctly rejected the high-risk workflow change for lacking a packet; it proves committed-range scope and is not represented as pre-edit admission.

GitHub exposes repository-secret names and update times but not PAT scope metadata. MERGEMASTERMIKE_PAT is already used by this repository for workflow dispatch; a dedicated fine-grained contents-write token remains the preferred authority.
The recovery fallback has no effect until this PR lands on main and a workflow_dispatch rebase run proves that a PAT-backed push creates exact-head CI.
Hosted exact-head CI, independent review, and human merge authority remain required.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the workflow, regression test, and this packet together. The workflow then returns to fail-closed rebase skipping when PR_CI_HEALTH_PUSH_TOKEN is absent.
